description: Two independent integrators on one panel: each one adds the voltage at its RATE input up over time and puts the running total on its SUM output

inputs.text: The voltage added into the running total each second: a steady 1V here raises SUM by 1V every second, and a negative voltage counts the total back down
Sets the running total back to 0V each time this rises above 0V; over a polyphonic cable only the channels whose own voltage rises are cleared

outputs.text: The running total in volts, one channel for each channel the RATE input carries; nothing limits how far it can go, so a steady rate will run it past any range

notes: the lower half does nothing until a cable is patched to the upper half's RATE input; the module stops at the end of the upper section while that jack has never carried a channel
the total is held when the RATE input is unpatched, and is written into the patch file, so a saved patch comes back with both totals where they were
Initialize on the right-click menu clears both totals and both channel counts, which is the only way to clear a section without a cable at its RESET input
menu: Save sum with patch — when this is off the totals are left out of the patch file, and the module comes back at 0V
